terms.name: Control air gap
terms.definition: An architectural separation between an agent’s ability to recommend, select, or plan an action and the authority or mechanism that permits consequential execution. Independent enforcement can maintain the separation even when the agent’s internal reasoning changes.

terms.name: Governability
terms.definition: A property of a consequential process describing the extent to which legitimate parties can understand, influence, constrain, correct, or recover its operation and outcomes. It does not imply complete predictability or a single controller.
